title_en: UNIQUE VILLA FOR SALE WITH A FANTASTIC VIEW IN THE AREA OF FARKA
description_en: For sale is an American-style villa positioned on a beautiful hill in Farka, with a fantastic panoramic view. A property designed for those looking for comfort, privacy and nature. The main features of the villa: • Plot area 500 m² • Construction area 240 m² • Floor area 0: 140 m², with 3 bedrooms, a living room and a complete kitchen. • Covered porch, ideal for relaxation and hospitality; • Spacious attic of about 100m2 with an open view; • Green yard 250 m² with parking for 2 cars; • Modern systems: Persian shutters, boiler heating + AC, camera system and external doors with control panel; • All rooms have light and natural lighting, offering a special feeling of comfort. A unique opportunity to invest in a villa with exceptional views, in a quiet and sought-after area of ​​Tirana, suitable for families who value privacy and comfort.
